clue.text: Model from quiet Spanish region

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction to play quietly
Aragon is a region of north-east Spain

explanation.surface: A fashion model hailing from a quiet corner of Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: A paragon is a perfect example, someone held up as a model to imitate.

clue.text: Troublesome child's tricky situation

definitions.meaning: a little ... is an affectionate term for a mischievous child
to be in a difficult predicament

explanation.surface: A naughty child has landed in a spot of bother.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are everyday idioms: a mischievous youngster, and a predicament or fix.

clue.text: Enthuse about one northern canyon

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the enthusing word goes around the other letters

parts.note: to rave is to enthuse wildly
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone gushing over a canyon in the north.
explanation.definitionFit: A ravine is a deep narrow gorge, a small canyon.

clue.text: Screen villain, red-headed, imprisoning elderly female

indicators.note: imprisoning means holding inside, so the hair colour encloses the other letters

parts.note: ginger describes someone with red hair
elderly means old

explanation.surface: A film baddie with red hair keeps an old woman captive.
explanation.definitionFit: Auric Goldfinger is the Bond villain of the 1964 film, a famous movie bad guy.

clue.text: Original book

definitions.meaning: new and inventive, never seen before

explanation.surface: A book that breaks new ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Novel as an adjective means new and original; as a noun it is a work of fiction.

clue.text: Fortitude of saint, a man I flogged

indicators.note: flogged suggests beaten about, so these letters are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: A martyr's endurance as he is whipped.
explanation.walkthrough: The saint and the flogged man look like one scene, but 'flogged' only scrambles the three short words into AMINA.
explanation.definitionFit: Stamina is staying power, the endurance and strength of fortitude.

clue.text: Newspaper proprietor checking daughter's drink

indicators.note: checking means holding back, so the press baron's letters hold the daughter's letter within

parts.note: The Sun is a British tabloid newspaper
a proprietor is an owner

explanation.surface: A press baron keeping an eye on how much his daughter drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: A sundowner is an alcoholic drink taken around sunset.

clue.text: Song from star I applauded

indicators.note: from signals the letters are taken out of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A star singer's piece that I clapped.
explanation.definitionFit: An aria is a solo song in an opera.

clue.text: Thought of a US soldier wearing denim pants

indicators.note: wearing means having on, so the soldier is inside the trousers' letters
pants as slang for rubbish or poor marks a jumbling of the letters of denim

parts.note: GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A GI in jeans comes to mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pants' looks like the trousers the soldier wears, but it is slang for rubbish, scrambling the fabric into IMNED; 'wearing' then sets the soldier inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Imagined means conceived or thought of in the mind.

clue.text: Yarn about party held by a teen in trouble

indicators.note: held by means kept inside the following letters
in trouble suggests disorder, so the letters of a teen are rearranged

parts.note: C is circa, Latin for about
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A tale of a troubled teenager at a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in trouble' rearranges A TEEN into ANETE, and 'held by' puts C and DO inside: ANE-CDO-TE.
explanation.definitionFit: A yarn is a story, and an anecdote is a short amusing story.

clue.text: Minor complaint from five in constant trouble

parts.note: C is the symbol for a constant, such as the speed of light

indicators.note: in places the numeral inside the word for trouble

parts.note: to ail is to trouble or afflict
V is the Roman numeral five

explanation.surface: A grumble from five people forever in difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: To cavil is to raise a petty objection, so a cavil is a trivial complaint.

clue.text: Clear leader in variety show

indicators.note: the leader in a word is its first letter

parts.note: to indicate is to show or point out

explanation.surface: The star of a variety show is cleared of blame.
explanation.definitionFit: To vindicate someone is to clear them of blame or suspicion.

clue.text: Poet's line about good companion

parts.note: on means about, as in a talk on a subject
a fellow is a companion or comrade

explanation.surface: A poet's verse about a good friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow was the American poet of Hiawatha.

clue.text: Good-natured family departs

parts.note: kin are one's family or relatives
D is the timetable abbreviation for departs

explanation.surface: A pleasant family heads off.
explanation.definitionFit: Kind means friendly, gentle and benevolent, which is good-natured.

clue.text: Cosmetic surgery, inconclusive as to outcome

definitions.meaning: slang for a minor cosmetic operation tightening the skin
describes a contest so close that the winner cannot be called, neck and neck

explanation.surface: A facelift whose results are uncertain.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is slang for a cosmetic operation and an idiom for a race too close to call.

clue.text: Diehard on the way, carrying information

indicators.note: carrying means holding within, so the travelling phrase contains the information

parts.note: in transit means on the way, travelling
gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: A stubborn traveller with news en route.
explanation.definitionFit: An intransigent is someone who refuses to compromise, an uncompromising hardliner.

clue.text: Fight back at atelier resolved

indicators.note: resolved here means broken down and reformed, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An artist's studio dispute finally settled.
explanation.definitionFit: To retaliate is to strike back against an attacker.

clue.text: Critical remark made by stalwart over club

indicators.note: in a down clue over means placed on top, so the stalwart's word comes first

parts.note: a brick is a reliable, stalwart person
a bat is a club

explanation.surface: A loyal supporter makes a cutting comment about a sports club.
explanation.definitionFit: A brickbat is a criticism or insult, literally a piece of brick thrown.

clue.text: Notice case I've left with European lawyer?

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement

indicators.note: left means departed, so those letters go from the grammatical case

parts.note: the vocative is the grammatical case used for addressing someone

explanation.surface: A notice about a case being dropped, involving a European lawyer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' removes IVE from VOCATIVE, leaving VOCAT. The question mark marks the definition as an example: an advocate is one kind of lawyer, as in Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: An advocate is a barrister, especially in Scotland, one type of lawyer.

clue.text: Memorable event, revolutionary character meeting Democrat, extremely angry

parts.note: a Red is a communist revolutionary
a letter is a written character

indicators.note: extremely picks the extreme letters, the first and last

explanation.surface: A political clash between a communist and a furious Democrat.
explanation.definitionFit: A red-letter day is a special, memorable occasion, from saints' days printed in red.

clue.text: Follow notice in exhibition

indicators.note: in places the notice inside the exhibition

parts.note: a show is an exhibition
an ad is a notice

explanation.surface: Following a notice at an exhibition.
explanation.definitionFit: To shadow someone is to follow them closely and secretly.

clue.text: Like athletes left in middle of Betws-y-Coed?

indicators.note: in places the word for left inside the central letters
the middle of a word is its central letters

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: Is a Welsh village full of athletic types?
explanation.walkthrough: Betws-y-Coed is a Welsh village; its middle two letters are S and Y, with PORT put between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Sporty means keen on and good at sport, as athletes are.

clue.text: Boast made by head of chorus line

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

parts.note: a row is a line

explanation.surface: Showing off at the front of the chorus line.
explanation.definitionFit: To crow is to brag or gloat.

clue.text: In which only brothers and sisters are employed?

definitions.text: In which only brothers and sisters are employed?

parts.words: In which only brothers and sisters are employed?
parts.note: trade unionists call fellow members brothers and sisters, so a workplace employing only union members is meant, not a family business

explanation.surface: A family firm that hires only siblings.
explanation.definitionFit: A closed shop is a workplace where every employee must belong to a trade union.

clue.text: Power of second crew

parts.note: a team is a crew

explanation.surface: The strength of the reserve crew.
explanation.definitionFit: Steam is power or energy, as in running out of steam.

clue.text: Shore bird in difficulty

definitions.meaning: a sandpiper-like wading bird of coasts
a tangle or problem, as in knotty

explanation.surface: A seabird in trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: The knot is a wading bird; a knot is also a tangled problem.

clue.text: A trendy wife included in bold idea

indicators.note: included in means placed inside, so the brave word holds the others

parts.note: brave means bold
in means fashionable, trendy

explanation.surface: A fashionable wife with a daring scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: A brainwave is a sudden clever idea.

clue.text: Inferior to a French wine knocked back

parts.note: un is French for a

indicators.note: knocked back means turned backwards, so the wine is read in reverse

parts.note: red is wine

explanation.surface: A second-rate French wine gulped down.
explanation.definitionFit: Under means lower in rank than, subordinate to.

clue.text: Hospital room: treat poorly ambassador inside

indicators.note: inside places the ambassador within the rearranged letters
poorly suggests badly done, so the letters of treat are rearranged

parts.note: HE is His Excellency, the title of an ambassador

explanation.surface: An ambassador in a hospital ward being treated badly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poorly' fits a hospital surface but here only scrambles the verb into TATRE; 'inside' then lodges His Excellency within it.
explanation.definitionFit: An operating theatre is the room in a hospital where surgery takes place.

clue.text: PM going round a botanic gardens site in advance

indicators.note: going round means surrounding, so the prime minister's name encloses the rest

parts.note: Theresa May was a British Prime Minister
Kew in London is home to the Royal Botanic Gardens

explanation.surface: A prime minister touring a botanic garden site beforehand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in advance' tempts as a phrase meaning beforehand, but 'in' is the link and 'advance' alone defines.
explanation.definitionFit: To make way is to make progress, to move forward.
